pixel_description: Photorealistic side view on soil with standing man right for scale. Twin-tube chassis frame is horizontal silver rails center, carrying wheels below and hopper/ladder above. Two rigid grouser wheels visible side-on (four total) bolted under chassis. Vertical narrow kerf chain at extreme front-left digging a slot. CRITICAL PART inclined bucket ladder: drawn as one long straight inclined steel truss/ladder frame from low front to high middle, about 50-60deg above horizontal, with 7 trapezoidal open buckets each heaped with brown soil spaced evenly along its left/up side from bottom to top, lower end pin-joined to chassis front adjacent to kerf chain collection box, mid supported by A-frame strut to chassis, upper discharge end free in air at top-center. Steep wedge hopper is single tapered sheet-steel tub center-right, pivot-bolted to chassis, tilted up rearward with large soil heap inside, pouring stream from rear discharge chute into small metal bin on ground right. Tilt screw discharge is screw conveyor visible diagonally under hopper plus rear chute. Two mast cameras on poles bolted to chassis front and mid. Black cables in chassis bay. Ladder top is far above and left of hopper with empty white air between; no chute connects ladder discharge to hopper inlet.

regions.observed: ladder top end free in air high above/left of hopper, buckets full and spilling, white air gap with no chute to hopper; hopper separately full and tilting
regions.expected: ladder top sprocket positioned over hopper with gravity chute dropping to hopper per sketch connection ladder->hopper and transfer line kerf -> ladder -> hopper

pixels show single screw conveyor under tilted hopper plus rear discharge chute pouring to bin, attached at rear pivot; extra 5 counts are grouser teeth/chain links mistaken for screws, inverted ratio due to wrong segmentation, contact present

pixels show enclosed dark chassis bay between wheels with cables where packs mount per fabrication step; internal packs not required externally visible in side photoview, electrical function not broken

pixels show two mast cameras (front-left and mid) with vertical poles bolted to chassis frame; thin masts cause mask gap, third camera of qty 3 occluded in side view; mounting present, 2-vs-3 is acceptable occlusion

deviations.why: pixels show chassis ~0.9-1.0m vs person consistent with spec; extra span is deployed pose: raised ladder height plus front kerf to rear discharge reach over bin, not stowed box; does not break box limit which applies stowed/folded

s1_differences: Ladder lift does not feed hopper: ladder discharge floats free while hopper is separate, breaking required kerf->ladder->hopper soil path. Otherwise chassis, kerf, wheels, hopper tilt, screw discharge to bin, and cameras match sketch arrangement.
s2_feedback: No design flaw claimed: hopper pivot on chassis and screw under hopper look supported with no interference; ladder-hopper air gap is a drawing fault in unfaithful render, not proof of impossible assembly.
notes: Photorealistic side view, not diagram/cartoon/CAD. Six callouts correctly spelled with no numbers pointing to correct assemblies. Standing person right is scale reference, metal tub is bin use-context. Ladder-hopper disconnect is the only fix-required fault.
